units.function: Express routes for public MCP protocol access, named-gateway/token administration, ephemeral session mint/revoke, direct Tool calls, approval decisions, runtime controls and audit search/projection.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends on Paperclip authz/access helpers, shared Tool schemas, Tool Gateway service, database activity/Agent/application/connection/Invocation tables and UI-oriented humanization. It exposes a Paperclip-specific mixed protocol/management API.
units.keyDataModels: Board or Agent actor, company membership/permission, gateway/token/session, ActionRequest, RuntimeSlot, activity/audit event and enriched Agent/application/connection/Tool projection.
units.lifecycle: Authenticates public bearer MCP requests or management actors, validates selected commands, delegates gateway execution/approval/runtime mutations and performs a paginated tenant-scoped audit query with display enrichment.
units.testAssessment: The linked 3,941-line acceptance suite exercises public MCP calls, viewer approval denial, Agent runtime/audit denial, explicit runtime/audit permissions, company/run revocation scope and audit pagination. It does not test viewer session mint/revoke, qualified approval authority, malformed/oversized protocol bodies, invalid outcome filters, broad-search scale or stable error-shape completeness. Local execution discovered but skipped all database tests, so no pass is claimed.
units.designRationale: Give Paperclip's board UI, Agent runtime and external MCP clients one HTTP surface over the large Tool Gateway service while reusing existing company membership and permission helpers.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs separately versioned Connector protocol and management APIs with explicit authority for session issuance, approval, runtime and evidence access, plus stable codes and bounded query/command contracts for independent Web/mobile clients.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE header-only bearer handling, tools:admin/manage_runtime/view_audit permissions, tenant-hiding queries, Agent run pinning, deterministic cursor pagination and structured ToolGateway reason codes. Define separate protocol and management surfaces with schema/size limits, purpose-specific session and approval permissions, ResponsibilityContract checks, redacted evidence projections and one stable error envelope.
units.responsibilityConflict: A board viewer can mint a live Agent-run bearer session and revoke known sessions because those routes require only company access. Every non-viewer member can approve or reject any company Tool action without risk/data scope, accountable-human assignment or separation of duties. Raw audit details are returned without read-time classification, and mixed English/ad hoc error shapes are not a stable client contract.
